name: Mai Tai Jeeter Infused Pre-Roll | 1g
description: Mai Tai is a tropical sativa strain that likely gets its sweet and tangy terpene profile from crossing Maui Waui with Tutti Frutti. Popping open a jar of Mai Tai, you’ll be greeted with notes of citrus and berries combined with undertones of fresh, damp earth and tropical flowers similar to what the cocktail offers. The taste is similar to the exhale, as its flavor aligns even more like the fruity cocktail it's named after. Mai Tai is the perfect strain for a lazy afternoon spent with family and friends. It leaves you feeling euphoric, relaxed, lifted and social.
